jit_object_verification.scope: Actual executable bytes from the same owned process sampled for CPU self time, captured only after sampling; original Object provenance exact. No timing scores or hardware retirement counts.

instruction_binding.scope: Every executable byte matches its genuine Object except explicitly decoded BL relocations, whose actual destinations must equal captured named JIT functions in the same PID. No code is executed from an Object.

interpretation.scope: Exact current accepted59, active closest-parity Seidel only. No official timing, source mutation, history append or holdout diagnosis.
interpretation.locations: 0xe30 private-owner flag stack load178 samples;0x1bc begins funding checks147;0xe20 old-cell/new-result compare115;0xbbc source matrix cell load84;0x3b4 bounds path78. These locate dependency chains, not exclusive instruction cost.
interpretation.static_comparison: Accepted59 holds work credit in x3, compares at0x1c8 and subtracts at0xe14 without hot credit stack roundtrip. Rejected rolling e5ac stores credit atSP+8, with header load0x1d8 and per-point load0xcc0/store0xcc8. Its F64 cache is already spill-free. Accepted private-owner flag usesSP+8; e5ac usesSP+16. No claim of hardware latency or causal decomposition from PC samples.
interpretation.next_direction: Reduce source-proved rolling cache control state. Its valid and pending bits plus maximum read column can be represented by a single last-read-column token if zero is reserved for inactive state. A successful complete fresh admission guarantees all one-based source columns, hence the maximum, are positive. Exact source closure leads directly to the sole write; no cache reuse is possible before successful write completion, and every error exits the loan. Nonfinite replay/COW/other state edges reset token to0; private/no-op writes retain it. Current shape and all full fresh checks remain. Validate empty/late/overflow/nonfinite/source-order/COW-denial cases and inspect actual credit register placement before any new-fingerprint probe. No weakening source fees or changing arithmetic.
